=== case 5148 category delete-token faults 1 diags 0 lexdiags 0 edits [("delete-token", 122, 5, "")]
--- orig

state tempo(96)
state energy(0.7)
state bloom(0.35)
state shift(0.12)
let pulse = energy * 0.5 + bloom * 0.25
let warm = pulse - shift * 0.4
let pitch = tempo / 60
fn lift(v, amt):
    v + amt * 0.6
fn fade(v, k):
    v * k - 0.05
fn swell(v, p):
    v * p + (energy - 0.5) * 0.2
pattern Phrase(root, next, depth, octave, tone):
    Clip:
        [Note/root Note/(root + 4) Note/(root + 7)]
        Note/(root + 2) | velocity=fade(lift(0.4, pulse), depth) brightness=warm + tone
